name: My Secret Ocean Boyfriend
source:
When your swim club is threatened with dissolution, it's up to you to find new members. Luckily, you manage to recruit three handsome men for your cause.

The only thing is... You've never seen any of these guys around campus before, and it feels like they're not really interested in swimming... They're interested in you!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.merman]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当你的游泳俱乐部面临解散威胁时，你需要寻找新成员。幸运的是，你设法为你的事业招募了三位英俊的男人。

唯一的问题是…你以前从未在校园里见过这些家伙，而且感觉他们对游泳并不真正感兴趣…他们对你感兴趣！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.merman]Google Play[/url]]
